## ClaudeMC v1.5

**Minecraft:** 1.21.1 · **Fabric Loader:** 0.16.5 · **Fabric API:** 0.100.7+1.21.1 · **Java:** 21

### New in v1.5

#### Custom Keybinds
Every module can now have its own hotkey to toggle it on/off without opening the GUI.
The key used to open the ClickGUI itself is also rebindable.

**How to use:**
1. Open the ClickGUI (`[.]` by default → now shows whatever key you set)
2. Click **[Keybinds]** in the bottom-right corner
3. Click any row to enter listening mode (row flashes blue)
4. Press the key you want — it binds instantly
5. Press **Delete/Backspace** to clear a bind, **Esc** to cancel

**Features:**
- Per-module hotkeys work in-game while no screen is open
- Bound key shown as a small grey hint next to each module name in the ClickGUI panels
- GUI open key is rebindable (first row in the Keybinds screen, marked in orange)
- All binds saved to `.minecraft/config/claudemc/keybinds.json` and loaded on startup
- Two-column scrollable layout in the Keybinds screen
